title: No-Spend Streak Recovery Time
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nospend:day
| sort 0 _time
| eval no_spend=if(status="success",1,0)
| streamstats current=t sum(eval(if(no_spend=1,1,0))) as streak reset_after="(no_spend=0)"
| stats max(streak) as best_streak, avg(streak) as avg_streak, latest(streak) as current_streak
description: Shows how quickly you get back into a no-spend rhythm after a broken streak.
value: Recovery after a miss is the difference between a useful habit and an all-or-nothing one.
implementation: Log each no-spend day with success or failure status; track best, average, and current streaks.
visualization: Streak summary tile with best, average, and current values.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how quickly you get back into no-spend days after a wobble, which matters more than never slipping at all.
